Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** a hand-typed object name is silently replaced, and in a namespaced package the publish gate then refuses it (`NAMESPACE_PREFIX`).
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. Re-read on `main` `5c0846ebd8`: `ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx:44`–`:49` holds the `nameTouched` ref. The claimant finds why it does not hold.

Claim: PM loop round 2
Session: `session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12680-object-name-survives-label`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12680`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#3`
File surface: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx` (the "name touched" guard: where the fact lives, so a direct Name edit survives a later Label edit across a remount); the host `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`, only where the remount or the Source tab's re-derivation is measured to start; the same guard in `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` and `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`, as the card asks, if the dev measures the same defect there; tests beside each (the pin goes through the real host); one `.changeset/12680-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; a lifecycle root cause to measure first; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the named paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (no export, prop or type changes; a typed name stops being overwritten)
Responsibility: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s object designer: `ObjectDefaultInspector`'s component-local `nameTouched` ref is `false` again when the label commits, so the label's slug replaces a hand-typed name in create mode | none covers it: the server takes the name it is sent, and in a namespaced package the publish gate then refuses the object with `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` | every author who types the name before the label in a new object, measured 2/2 on fresh loads (the card's reproduction, showcase boot)
Thread-read: 6218298926
Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12681 (`pm:queue`, p2, same area, `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`) is answered not-fold, by gate ①: a different defect shape (a `formula: undefined` own key read as unrecognized) and a different file, so the surfaces are disjoint and the two can run in parallel. No in-flight `domain:ui` claim and no open objectui PR names `ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` or `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`, read across the lane's `pm:dispatched` claims and every open PR's file list, 2026-10-16T16:16Z. The guard is as the card quotes it on `main` (`ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx:44`).
